value.loc: Section 1, p.2; Abstract, p.1; Theorem 1.1, p.3
value.quote: single-winner voting rule defined on (weak) ordinal preference ballots
value.note: The rule is defined on weak orders. Several main results (Theorems 1.1, 4.1, 5.3; Propositions 3.2, 3.3) take the weighted majority graph as input: 'When the input is the weighted majority graph'. Linear orders appear only as special instances in the lower-bound constructions, not as the input format.

C2.2.reason: The input format is weak orders, and the weighted majority graph is the stated input of several main results, so PAIR applies; strict rankings occur only as special cases inside the reductions, so RANK does not.

value.quote_behav: A preference profile P (or a multiset of votes) is a list
value.note: Voters give ballots, which are fixed weak orders taken as given input; the codebook counts fixed actions as presence.

C6.VOT.reason: The codebook counts a type as present when its action is fixed, and voters give ballots in the model ('the voters give (weak) ordinal preference ballots'), so voters are present and NONSTRAT.
